# Attribution and rights: HABITAT-DETAILS-V1

**Geometry.** All of it is original. It is generated by the scripts in `source/`, written for the OUT OF REACH team on 14 November 2026. No third-party models, scans, photographs or AI-generated images are used.

**Textures.** All of them are procedural (numpy/Pillow) and original:
- **`A7_*` sets:** copied unchanged from the AURORA-7 ship. They were generated by `a7_textures.py`, which is included.
- **`HB_Leaf`:** generated by `source/hb_textures.py`.
- **`HB_Labels` atlas:** drawn by `source/hb_textures.py`. The small photos in it are procedural landscapes: no people and no real places.

**Fonts.** Only rendered pixels are used; no font file is redistributed. Both fonts come with Blender:
- **Inter** (SIL Open Font License 1.1) for the label text.
- **DejaVu Sans Mono** (Bitstream Vera license, public domain changes) for the ration lot codes.

**Insignia and brands.** None. Ration labels carry generic names and lot codes. No NASA, ESA or other agency mark is used.

**Inputs consulted for the berth design** (Codex's sleep brief of 14 November 2026). No content is copied from them:
- [NASA Medical Operations reference](https://www.nasa.gov/reference/6-0-medical-operations/): 8.5 h sleep opportunity.
- [NASA OCHMO-TB-041 Sleep Accommodations](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/ochmo-tb-041-sleep-accommodations.pdf): secured bag, restraints, ventilation and CO2.
- [ESA, "An astronaut's rhythm"](https://www.esa.int/articles/an-astronaut-s-rhythm): local light cues.

**Licence.** The package is the team's own work and may be used in the game and its showcase under the project's terms.
